label: Web Search
description: Search the web (semantic or keyword, picked per query) and get results with their page text, ready for an LLM step. Uses Exa.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Exa access (wire an ExaAccess node).

inputs.name: maxTextChars
inputs.label: Text per result
inputs.description: Max page-text characters per result. `numResults` times this (plus titles and URLs) must stay under the 100 KB wire limit; the default keeps ten results near 40 KB. Ignored when `includeText` is off.

inputs.name: includeDomains
inputs.description: Only results from these domains. Empty = the whole web.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Each result: title, url, publishedDate, text.
